notice_text:
Note:
 i)  This is to inform you that every month bill must be paid by the 16th of the following month. 
      If payment is not received by the due date,the connection/line will be disconnected
      without further notice.
ii )  Payment may be made either by cheque  in favour of Tata Steel Ltd  or in cash
 iii)  This is to inform all holders of the premises that a person will be appointed for the 
       purpose   i) Generating bills and ii) collecting payments from each holder.The remunaration 
      of said person will be arranged and shared  equally . You are requested to kindly extend 
      your cooperation in this matter,
  iv)  Park your vehicle  in the  Garrage  area  alloted to you .
 v ) Fixed meter charges has increased from May'26 onwords
